io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.services

Class MachineAuditService

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.services.MachineAuditService

  • public class MachineAuditService
extends java.lang.Object
    Boot-time audit of machines and multiblocks that still use a superseded API, mirroring the translation audit: a console warning per category plus the full per-addon list on disk, so a migration gap stays visible instead of silently degrading in game.
    See Also:
    ItemTranslationService.auditUnmigratedLore(File)
